name: Window Prep (Substrate-Specific)
intent: Prep tasks gate by substrate type AND substrate state. Wood windows need sand+fill (bare) or scuff (factory primed). Aluminum needs degrease+etch. Steel needs degrease+rust treatment. All substrates get a final clean pass before primer.
doctrine: Wood prep (sand + fill) only fires for bare wood; factory-primed wood gets a faster scuff. Metal prep is substrate-specific: aluminum needs etching for paint adhesion, steel needs rust treatment. The degrease step is shared between aluminum and steel (gated by substrate=[aluminum, steel]). All paths converge on the final clean step before primer.
